m1.typescript: m1 each convention loads for exactly the files of its area

e1.typescript: e1 the root file is short and holds only what every task needs

e2.typescript: e2 the review command is shared read only and says what it does

e3.typescript: e3 the settings protect the environment file and approve no whole tool

e4.typescript: e4 the modes table sends open design work to plan mode and clear small work to direct

e5.typescript: e5 every rule scopes itself with a glob that matches a file

e6.typescript: e6 no file holds a personal path an address or a key

wrong-docs-unscoped.defect: leaves the documentation rule without paths, so it loads in every session

wrong-handlers-wide.defect: scopes the handlers rule to every ts file, so it also loads for the database files

wrong-tests-folder.defect: scopes the testing rule to one folder, so test files elsewhere miss it

wrong-tests-ts-only.defect: scopes the testing rule to the ts files and leaves the tsx files out

wrong-root-keeps-hooks.defect: leaves one component convention in the root file

wrong-root-long.defect: pads the root file past twenty-five lines

wrong-review-bare-bash.defect: pre approves the whole Bash tool in the review command

wrong-review-no-description.defect: leaves the description out of the review command

wrong-bash-allow.defect: approves the whole Bash tool in the settings

wrong-monolith-direct.defect: sends the restructuring of the monolith to direct execution

wrong-typo-plan.defect: sends a one-line typo fix through plan mode

wrong-home-path.defect: writes a personal home path into the root file
